## GPT Image 2.6 Flare API

GPT Image 2.6 Flare is an image generation and image editing model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `gpt-image-2-6-flare`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

GPT Image 2.6 Flare is the faster tier of OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6, giving high-fidelity results for campaign and product work at lower latency. It renders at up to 4K and pairs with GPT Image 2.6 Flare Edit.

### GPT Image 2.6 Flare API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gpt-image-2-6-flare` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.09 / image |
| `gpt-image-2-6-flare-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.10 / edit |

Prices by `quality` for `gpt-image-2-6-flare`, `high` when left out:

| Quality | 1K | 2K | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|
| low | $0.05 | $0.08 | $0.12 |
| medium | $0.07 | $0.13 | $0.20 |
| high | $0.09 | $0.15 | $0.24 |

### GPT Image 2.6 Flare specifications

| Spec | Value |

| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the GPT Image 2.6 Flare API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "gpt-image-2-6-flare"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-image-2-6-flare",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
